messages:
mike_support: Heads up — several customers (starting with AcmeCorp) reporting missing hourly usage in the Console. Gap from ~02:00-08:00 UTC. Seen in the hourly rollups and the per-tenant table is empty for those hours. Not a UI bug, looks like missing data from ETL. Anyone oncall?

lucy: I'm looking now. Confirmed: hourly rollups for tenant acme_corp are missing between 02:00 and 08:00 UTC. The ingestion consumer logs show repeated deserialization errors around 01:53-02:05, then the consumer group rebalance and high lag. Snippet from consumer log: 
```
ERROR deserializer - Failed to deserialize message at offset 1234567: Unknown field 'session_id' in event schema
Caused by: org.apache.avro.SchemaValidationException: Unknown field: session_id
Consumer will skip message and continue
```

lucy: Looks like the new field was added in the producer deploy; the consumer didn't accept it and skipped some messages during restart.

dan: Did the deploy-bot show a schema change or feature flag around 01:50 UTC? Could be a new event shape rolled out.

deploy-bot: Deployment #4573 (events-service) completed at 01:52:18 UTC. Change: add optional 'session_id' to EventV2 payload. 

dan: OK. If the consumer didn't update Avro/serde compatibility it might throw and, depending on config, skip/commit offsets. That would leave holes. Any sign offsets were committed past the bad messages?

lucy: Yes — after the rebalance the consumer group shows offsets advanced by ~300k and there's a gap in processed offsets. Topic retention is 72h so the messages are still available, but our consumer was configured with auto.offset.reset=latest and the restart path advanced without replay.

mike_support: That explains customer alerts. Can we reprocess the missing offsets to backfill hourly aggregates? Is there a backfill job we can run scoped by tenant/time?

lucy: We have reprocess-usage backfill. I'll kick a targeted backfill for acme_corp for 02:00-08:00 UTC. Command I'm running: 
```
./bin/backfill --job reprocess-usage --tenant acme_corp --start 2026-03-10T02:00Z --end 2026-03-10T08:00Z --parallel 4
```
Starting job bf-20260310-acme-01. Estimated wall time ~2.5-3h based on previous runs.

andrew: Customers are asking for ETA — please keep me updated so I can reply to SLAs.

lucy: ETA ~2.5h, partial hourly tiles will appear incrementally as shards complete. I also created a dashboard annotation and a support note to explain ongoing backfill.

dan: I'll patch the consumer to tolerate the new optional field and update Avro registry compatibility. Pushing hotfix now — PR: https://git.redwood.example/p/events/merge_requests/789

dan: After patch I'll redeploy a consumer canary with from-beginning set to false but with a recovery path to reprocess, and we'll run the legacy consumer to explicitly rewind and replay the missed offsets into the ETL pipeline if the backfill stalls.

tara_sre: Recommending we also temporarily increase topic retention to 7d to be safe while we reprocess. Changing retention from 72h -> 168h for topic events-prod. I'll make the change and monitor.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment initiated for events-consumer v2.1-hotfix at 02:45 UTC.

mike_support: Any manual workaround we can give customers in the meantime?

lucy: For immediate workaround, customers can use the raw usage-export (S3) which is unaffected, or run a tenant-scoped query against raw_events to reconstruct recent activity; I added a support playbook with the query.

lucy: Backfill job bf-20260310-acme-01 started successfully. Map-reduce shards 0/12 complete. Will post progress here.

[later] lucy: Update — shards 6/12 complete, hourly tiles for 02:00-05:00 are appearing in the Console (partial). Backfill ETA ~1.5h remaining.

dan: Hotfix merged and picked up by canary consumer. Consumer now accepts optional session_id and no longer throws during deserialize. We're safe for new events.

lucy: Backfill finished. All hourly rollups for acme_corp present now (02:00-08:00 UTC). Verified by sanity queries and Console charts now show contiguous data.

mike_support: Great work, thanks everyone. I'll notify customers and close escalations. Suggestion: add integration test for event schema forward-compatibility and add a post-deploy check to validate consumer group lag < 1s for 10 minutes.

andrew: Thanks — customers updated. Marking incident as resolved but will follow up on the post-deploy checks. :thumbsup:
